protocol: Six clustered paired-context rounds. Two baseline roles and hybrid, all six permutations; context order alternates. Both contexts use env -C. Relative invocation also changes CWD alongside argv0 and AT_EXECFN. Normal ASLR,CPU2,one bounded procbench round per ordinary shared lock. Whole wall/resources include env/chdir/extraexec; same helper does not establish identical overhead. Backend internal timing/counters remain separate, no external PMU group. Six clusters, not864 independent source comparisons. Even medians midpoint central pair.
